# WM Suite Hub

> Central cockpit for the WM Suite plugin family: spoke registry, health matrix, HMAC-SHA256 audit chain in one table, 16 server-rendered Gutenberg blocks and a Borlabs Cookie consent bridge. It makes no legal assessment.

## Overview


- WP-CLI: `wp wm-hub`, `wp wm-sdk`
- REST: `wm-hub/v1` (capability `manage_wm_suite`) and `wm-suite/v1/consent-sync` (Borlabs bridge, nonce and rate limit)
- Storage: `{prefix}wm_suite_audit_log`
- No shortcode, no export, no outbound request
- Version 1.2.6.

## Standards

- PHP 8.2+ / Strict Types / PSR-12 / WPCS
- Zero-CDN Invariant (self-hosted assets in `/assets/`)
- Nonce & capability verification / late escaping / prepared SQL

## Official Links
